feature_name: Storage Transfer Service Amazon S3 CloudFront domain transfer support
summary: Storage Transfer Service added support for transferring data from Amazon S3 via CloudFront domain endpoints.
extended_definition: Storage Transfer Service added support for transferring data from Amazon S3 via CloudFront domain endpoints.
